Q5738.reason: Under the predominant-purpose test the UCC governs only if the goods were the predominant part of the deal, and the $1,200 service charge exceeds the $1,000 laptop price, so the result is uncertain.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and the defendant entered the open party to have fun and formed the theft intent only afterward.

Q8324.reason: Agitation and urgent drug-seeking fit chronic drug exposure, which downregulates postsynaptic dopamine receptors, while cell death in dopamine areas would not produce this picture.
